cover.coreProposition: Working-memory governance must evaluate stored state, delivered context, management work, and task/process outcome separately; nominal token budget or final success cannot substitute for layer-specific, version-bound evidence.
cover.visualMetaphor: One fixed capacity frame contains four distinct luminous evidence planes that do not align automatically
cover.semanticObject: A deep frame crossed by four offset translucent layers with one execution path passing through them
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape editorial cover with a single bounded frame, four depth-separated planes and a clear path whose alignment changes across layers
